what_is_closed: The exact normal-incidence two-face boundary-map composition has a nonzero fixed amplitude.
Therefore no single positive-definite quadratic norm can make both face maps strict contractions on every nonzero amplitude.
This rules out strict per-face contraction in a common norm as a proof route for this algebraic lane.
what_remains_open: Existence of a common positive-definite nonincreasing form with semidefinite defects is not decided.
The face-map composition is not a spatial propagation operator and does not establish a slab eigenmode or instability.
An evolution energy estimate for the full first-order GH system, tangential frequencies, variable coefficients, and corners remains open.

equation_or_mapping.maps: q=M_right p at the +x face; q=M_left p at the -x face, using the exact KRSW normal-incidence maps
equation_or_mapping.fixed_vector: M_left*M_right*v=v, with v_(t,y)=v_(x,y)=1 and all other components zero
equation_or_mapping.strict_contraction_no_go: If H is common and positive definite and both M_s^T H M_s < H, then v^T H v > (M_right*v)^T H(M_right*v) > (M_left*M_right*v)^T H(M_left*M_right*v)=v^T H v, a contradiction.
equation_or_mapping.weak_form_obligation: For H>0 and defects D_s=H-M_s^T H M_s >=0, the fixed cycle requires D_right*v=0 and D_left*(M_right*v)=0; these neutral-subspace equalities do not by themselves decide feasibility.

major_result.units: Dimensionless amplitudes in the flat-background linearized standard-GR normal-incidence lane.
major_result.derivation_class: exact rational matrix composition and quadratic-form contradiction
major_result.observable: spectral contraction property of the declared algebraic face maps; not a physical observable
major_result.data_role: internal exact algebra based on a published standard-GR boundary comparator; no empirical data, fitting, or holdout
open_blockers: common semidefinite quadratic-form feasibility or a full two-sided discrete energy estimate
mapping the one-face algebra to a spatially evolved GH slab with compatible corners
major_result.claim_boundary: No-go only for strict common contraction of these exact normal-incidence face maps; not a no-go for nonincreasing energy, slab stability, full GH CPBC, UET, or Gravity.

source.title: Boundary conditions for coupled quasilinear wave equations with application to isolated systems
source.locator: Section IV.1, equations (55)-(67) and the harmonic constraints immediately following equation (67)

assumptions: The two maps are the exact normal-incidence maps in the source-hashed one-face artifact.
A common norm means the same positive-definite H is used for both oriented faces.
Strict contraction is required for every nonzero input vector at each face.
not_assumed_or_proved: No composition of face maps is identified with propagation through a finite-width slab.
No result is asserted for a common nonincreasing norm or the full evolved GH equations.
